content:
Sofia: Seeing a bunch of overnight overage flags for a few customers. Looks correlated with the midnight batch
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for metering.alerts (P2) — high token-count variance detected for window 00:00-01:00 UTC — paging oncall @Kevin
Kevin: on it, paging into #incidents-call. Can someone dump the emitter lag stats?
Priya: pulling metrics now. early look: emitter queue depth spiked ~00:12 UTC and stayed ~5-7 mins, then a replay burst around 00:19.
Priya: snippet from emit logs:
```
2026-03-17T00:12:08Z emitter/queue.go INFO depth=124 stalled_for=00:03:12
2026-03-17T00:19:03Z emitter/producer.go INFO replay_window=46ms msg_batch=512
```
Angus: sounds like the midnight compaction job stalled and retried, causing duplicate-ish events? Could explain token-sample-window drift.
Sofia: customers are seeing email alerts about overages. We should mute outgoing overage notifications until we assess.
Kevin: Agree — will mute the notification job. @ops-bot can you run `jobs/mute overage_notifications --reason "investigating midnight emitter replay"`?
ops-bot: command accepted: muted overage_notifications (actor: Kevin) — will persist for 2h unless cleared.
Priya: Quick recon: meter counts (primary aggregator) vs shadow ledger show a +12% delta for the affected window. Not uniform across customers; top-affected tenants have lots of short-chat sessions.
Sofia: Could be prefix caching + replay causing token double-counting when KV TTLs clashed. Any evidence of duplicate event ids?
Priya: Searching — some duplicate event_ids with same trace_id, originating from emitter instance em-07.
Angus: em-07 had a restart around 00:10 UTC per infra logs. Restart + producer backpressure might have triggered re-emit.
Kevin: Action list: 1) mute notifications (done) 2) isolate em-07's replay pipeline 3) run a targeted dedupe pass on midnight window 4) communicate to customers on impacted tenants if needed. Who owns dedupe?
Priya: I'll run dedupe job: `tools/dedupe --from=2026-03-17T00:00Z --to=2026-03-17T01:00Z --tenant-filter=top-10-affected`
Sofia: Good. Also start a ledger diff job to get precise refund/credits plan. We should avoid manual credits until we have exact numbers.
incident-bot: update: oncall handoff requested by Kevin to Priya at 1719999000 (planned 15m takeover)
Kevin: Handoff in 10m — briefing: muted notifications, em-07 isolated, dedupe job queued, infra investigating restart cause. If dedupe clears delta to <1%, we won't reach out to customers.
Priya: dedupe running now. ETA ~8m. Posting progress logs here.
Priya: dedupe log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T00:45:12Z dedupe/main.go INFO scanned=1.2M candidates deduped=52K tenants=8
2026-03-17T00:50:09Z dedupe/main.go INFO window_delta_percent=11.6
```
Sofia: okay delta ~11.6% matches earlier. Can we identify invoice-impacting tokens vs systemic noise?
Priya: yes — splitting by session length. Most excess comes from sessions <30s where prefix cache invalidation + replay overlapped. We'll produce a per-tenant rollback plan.
Angus: infra root cause: em-07's consumer thread hit a GC pause due to a bad metrics snapshot; we pushed a hotfix to reduce snapshot frequency. em-07 is back on stable. Patch: https://git.internal/r/infra/emitter/patch/2026-03-17
Kevin: Good. After dedupe completes, run a dry-reconcile to estimate true exposure. Priya, can you post a table of top-5 tenants with projected credits?
Priya: posting soon. also tagging @Sofia for customer comms decision.
Priya: dry-recon results (summary):
- tenant-a: projected overcount 24,500 tokens (~$12.30)
- tenant-b: 18,900 tokens (~$9.45)
- tenant-c: 11,200 tokens (~$5.60)
- tenant-d: 4,700 tokens (~2.35)
- tenant-e: 3,100 tokens (~1.55)
(total sample scope: top-250 tenants)
Sofia: These are small per-tenant amounts. Recommend NOT contacting customers but apply automatic ledger adjustments for anything >$5. Ops, confirm thresholds?
Kevin: Policy check: small credits under $10 can be auto-applied with internal note. I'll greenlight automatic ledger adjustments for projected credit <= $20; anything above we escalate to billing for manual review.
ops-bot: ledger-adjust-preview created: /internal/billing/preview/1719998765 — includes 47 tenants flagged, 12 above $20.
Priya: dedupe run finished; final window_delta_percent=11.1. Running final reconcile now.
Priya: final_recon snippet:
```
2026-03-17T00:58:59Z reconcile.go INFO reconciled_scope=top-500 tenants_adjusted=59 total_tokens_adj=1.1M total_credit_est=$552.40
```
Sofia: thanks. Kevin, can you update incident status and mark customer-impact=low? We'll keep notes for postmortem.
Kevin: Incident status: mitigation in place, notifications muted, dedupe/reconcile completed, infra patch deployed to emitter snapshotting. Customer-impact: low (auto credits applied for <=$20; billing team looped for larger credits). Handoff to follow-up owner Priya for postmortem and invoice adjustments.
incident-bot: incident update recorded. severity=P2, impact=low, owner=Priya, followup-tag=billing-reconcile-2026-03-17
Priya: I'll own the postmortem and follow-up: include timeline, em-07 GC pause root cause, dedupe procedure, and operational checklist to mute notif + reconcile. ETA for postmortem doc: EOD today.
Sofia: thanks everyone. Leaving notes here and closing channel sync. :thumbsup:
